q1_issues.issue: The copular predication itself is never emitted: "X is a ... member" is a categorical statement, so Categorical statements mandates (Member sailsworn member), but the parse records the clause only as the PartOf link, leaving "Is Sailsworn a member?" unbindable.

notes: The PartOf link is itself licensed — PartOf's second job is "a member of a group", and the proper-noun-premodifier rule allows a more specific relation than Possession when the words state one — and treating "Council" as a capitalized common-noun label (witness + type atom, no Name) follows Names and casing. Only the head noun's own typing atom is missing.
